rule: Count 4-connected nonzero components by color, sort colors by decreasing component count then increasing color, make a square whose side is the total component count, draw the leading color on the main diagonal, and right-align one top-row bar per color with length equal to its component count.
note: The blind prediction matched pair 4 exactly; the same rule also reproduced pairs 5 through 29 exactly, so all 30 supplied pairs are consistent in this bounded visual review.
